scope: Compare current public Autorun sources with Sleeping Dogs v8; no runtime or package changes in this review.

build_identifiers.note: Backend-conditional source identifiers, not interchangeable release numbers.

local.fex_port_origin: FEXTendo / AndroSwitch Project / Ibnuard's own Switch integration of upstream FEX-Emu, inherited here from pes13-fex; not imported from Autorun's FEX integration.
local.note: The base release describes inherited Wine-NX/Wine runtime code only. FEXTendo's own FEX port, fixes and selected backports are layered over it; the commit count does not count missing fixes.
existing_capabilities: FEX translator with the Fastest profile and existing MTrack support
Low guest address support and native heap placement above 4 GiB
Working processor topology, validated with Sleeping Dogs four-worker startup
Optional DXVK HUD None/FPS/Full and Performance graphics profile
v8 interval counters for hardware performance diagnosis

backport_candidates.feature: Allow DXVK shader workers and Vulkan pipeline compilation to migrate across application cores
backport_candidates.local_status: Absent: no migrate_shader_locked, NX_SHADER_AFFINITY or wine_nx_thread_pipeline_begin in the relevant native source files.
backport_candidates.mechanism: Mask eligible shader work onto application cores 0-2, preserve explicit guest affinity and thread priority, and restore affinity after scoped pipeline compilation.
backport_candidates.expected_benefit_inference: Can reduce shader compilation contention and stutter; a sustained gameplay FPS improvement is unmeasured.
backport_candidates.integration_requirement: Reconcile with the project's stable balancer, core-3 opt-in and guest-affinity handling; test restoration, renamed workers, fixed affinity and failure paths.

backport_candidates.feature: Reuse temporary Mesa NAK shader compiler allocations
backport_candidates.local_status: Absent: the v8 source manifest lacks shader_alloc_cache.c and shader_compile.c.
backport_candidates.mechanism: Thread-local allocation reuse inside nak_compile_shader; 1 MiB cache limit per active worker, up to eight cache-enabled workers; drains on scope exit or allocation pressure.
backport_candidates.expected_benefit_inference: Reduces allocator work during shader compilation. This is not a cache of finished shaders and does not prove higher FPS after shaders are compiled.
backport_candidates.integration_requirement: Adapt native-heap accounting and allocator wrappers; preserve alignment, realloc semantics, bounded memory use and draining.

backport_candidates.feature: Optional Horizon queued synchronization waits and targeted wakeups
backport_candidates.local_status: Absent: no horizon_fast_sync backend in local horizon.c. Existing local synchronization experiments are not this backend.
backport_candidates.expected_benefit_inference: Potentially relevant to steady performance if server waits or synchronization overhead dominate; v7 does not measure this sufficiently.
backport_candidates.integration_requirement: Use the queued-wait implementation and its follow-up semantics, not just the initial direct-sync commit. Keep Standard as a selectable fallback and validate events, semaphores, APCs, timers, suspension and cancellation.

backport_candidates.feature: Gate server request timing and counters when profiling is disabled
backport_candidates.local_status: Local server_call_unlocked always reads ticks and updates atomic request counters; no horizon_server_profile_enabled gate.
backport_candidates.expected_benefit_inference: Removes per-request observer work when no report consumer is enabled; impact is unmeasured.
backport_candidates.integration_requirement: Keep counters enabled for v8 diagnostic runs. Only disable when neither profiling nor interval counters consume them.

other_findings.feature: SD read-ahead, cache reuse and buffered writes
other_findings.assessment: Potential streaming improvement, conditional on SD counters. Preserve the local memory budget and file semantics.
The cached-writable-file regression fixed upstream is not present in the inspected older local open path. Do not claim this fix applies directly.
Native heap tracking avoids Vulkan budget scans upstream; the local normal DXVK path already disables that memory-budget extension, so benefit on that path is not established.

other_findings.feature: Processor topology and fast FEX settings
other_findings.assessment: Already addressed locally; newer upstream code is not evidence that these optimizations are all missing. The ARM64EC upstream integration is different from the local adapter and is not a drop-in version-number change.

performance_evidence.hardware: Switch OLED handheld; CPU 1728 MHz, GPU 768 MHz, RAM 1600 MHz
performance_evidence.bottleneck_status: Unresolved. Short Present duration does not exclude GPU waits elsewhere; FEX compilation time is not shader compilation time or translated-code execution time.
performance_evidence.required_for_target: 30 FPS requires about 33.33 ms per frame, roughly 43 percent less frame time than the measured segment.
performance_evidence.next_hardware_comparison: Same scene, same clocks, normal Launch, HUD FPS, v8 counters: 60 seconds at 720p and 60 seconds at 960x540 after warm-up. Preserve each run's log.
performance_evidence.undefined_graphics_level: Unresolved; no DisplaySettings.xml supplied. No reviewed upstream change establishes a fix for this label.

reported_examples: Quake III demo: about 37 FPS at 1280x720 OpenGL
NFS Underground 2: roughly 20-45 FPS with wined3d and CPU overclocking
upstream_benchmark_limits.note: The first three numbers are explicitly older Mesa 20.1 measurements. No Sleeping Dogs benchmark was found in the reviewed repository documentation; this does not disprove external video reports.

frame_generation.available_upstream: Optional LSFG-VK 2x, requires the user's Lossless.dll.
frame_generation.note: Base render FPS and displayed FPS after frame generation are different measurements. The user's referenced 60 FPS demonstrations have not been identified, so their use of frame generation is unknown.

conclusion: Real upstream optimization candidates are missing locally. Prioritize a controlled shader-affinity backport and allocation-cache evaluation, then synchronization according to v8 measurements. Stable 30 FPS is not established by the available evidence.
